tools.name: pointofrental_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people linked to customers, vendors or your organization), with phones, emails and addresses. Supports search on Name, Emails.Email and Phones.Number. Elite and Syrinx. GET /apikey/contacts.

tools.name: pointofrental_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id, including its phones, emails and additional fields. Elite and Syrinx. GET /apikey/contacts/{ContactId}.

tools.name: pointofrental_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with their status, classification, payment terms and contacts. Supports search on Name, Identifiers.CustomerKey, address fields and Phones.Number. Elite and Syrinx. GET /apikey/customers.

tools.name: pointofrental_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id: status, credit limit, terms, contacts and receivable balance. Elite and Syrinx. GET /apikey/customers/{CustomerId}.

tools.name: pointofrental_get_customer_outstanding_invoices
tools.description: Get the outstanding invoice totals for one customer (amounts still owed). Elite, Syrinx and Essentials. GET /apikey/invoices/totals/{CustomerId}.

tools.name: pointofrental_list_contracts
tools.description: List contracts: rental agreements, reservations and quotes, with status and dates. Elite and Syrinx. GET /apikey/contracts.

tools.name: pointofrental_get_contract
tools.description: Get one contract by id: customer, dates, status, line items, totals and workflow state. Elite and Syrinx. GET /apikey/contracts/{ContractId}.

tools.name: pointofrental_list_products
tools.description: List rental products (the catalog items you rent out), with categories and model data. Supports search on Name and Identifiers.Key. Elite and Syrinx. GET /apikey/products.

tools.name: pointofrental_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by id: description, categories, model and images. Elite and Syrinx. GET /apikey/products/{ProductId}.

tools.name: pointofrental_get_product_availability
tools.description: Get the availability of one product across depots, optionally for a date window (startdate and enddate, ISO 8601). Elite and Syrinx. GET /apikey/products/{ProductId}/availability.

tools.name: pointofrental_list_stock
tools.description: List stock records: individual serialized units and bulk stock, with status, serial number and depot. Supports search on Name and Identifiers.Key. Elite and Syrinx. GET /apikey/stock.

tools.name: pointofrental_get_stock_item
tools.description: Get one stock record by id: serial number, status, depot, purchase and depreciation data. Elite and Syrinx. GET /apikey/stock/{StockId}.

tools.name: pointofrental_get_stock_availability
tools.description: Get the real-time availability of one stock record (a serialized unit or bulk stock), with its expected returns. Elite and Syrinx. GET /apikey/stock/{StockId}/availability.

tools.name: pointofrental_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with customer, dates, totals and amount due. GET /apikey/invoices.

tools.name: pointofrental_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id: customer, invoice date, due date, totals and amount due. GET /apikey/invoices/{InvoiceId}.

tools.name: pointofrental_list_work_orders
tools.description: List work orders (maintenance and repair jobs on stock), with status, type and due date. GET /apikey/workOrders.

tools.name: pointofrental_get_work_order
tools.description: Get one work order by id: stock item, status, complaint, cause, correction, labor and parts. GET /apikey/workOrders/{WorkOrderId}.

tools.name: pointofrental_list_line_items
tools.description: List contract line items: the rented products and quantities on contracts. GET /apikey/lineItems.

tools.name: pointofrental_list_locations
tools.description: List your locations (branches and yards) with address and identifiers. Elite and Syrinx. GET /apikey/locations.

tools.name: pointofrental_list_depots
tools.description: List depots (the stock and fulfilment sites), with identifiers. Supports search on Name and Identifiers.Key. Elite and Syrinx. GET /apikey/depots.

tools.name: pointofrental_list_categories
tools.description: List product and stock categories used to group rental inventory. Elite and Syrinx. GET /apikey/categories.

tools.name: pointofrental_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact with a name and optional email and phone. Creates a live record. Elite only. POST /apikey/contacts.

tools.name: pointofrental_update_contact
tools.description: WRITE: change the listed fields of one contact. Only the fields you pass change. Elite only. PATCH /apikey/contacts/{ContactId}.

tools.name: pointofrental_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer with a name and optional email and phone. Creates a live record. Elite only. POST /apikey/customers.

tools.name: pointofrental_update_customer
tools.description: WRITE: change the listed fields of one customer. Only the fields you pass change. Does not change balances or credit limits unless you pass them. Elite only. PATCH /apikey/customers/{CustomerId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pointofrental_list_contacts, pointofrental_get_contact · Private data: pointofrental_list_contacts, pointofrental_get_contact, pointofrental_list_customers, pointofrental_get_customer, pointofrental_get_customer_outstanding_invoices, pointofrental_list_contracts, pointofrental_get_contract, pointofrental_list_products, pointofrental_get_product, pointofrental_get_product_availability, pointofrental_list_stock, pointofrental_get_stock_item, pointofrental_get_stock_availability, pointofrental_list_invoices, pointofrental_get_invoice, pointofrental_list_work_orders, pointofrental_get_work_order, pointofrental_list_line_items, pointofrental_list_locations, pointofrental_list_depots, pointofrental_list_categories, pointofrental_create_contact, pointofrental_update_contact, pointofrental_create_customer, pointofrental_update_customer · Public sink: pointofrental_list_contacts, pointofrental_create_contact, pointofrental_create_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pointofrental_list_contacts, pointofrental_get_contact · Private data: pointofrental_list_contacts, pointofrental_get_contact, pointofrental_list_customers, pointofrental_get_customer, pointofrental_get_customer_outstanding_invoices, pointofrental_list_contracts, pointofrental_get_contract, pointofrental_list_products, pointofrental_get_product, pointofrental_get_product_availability, pointofrental_list_stock, pointofrental_get_stock_item, pointofrental_get_stock_availability, pointofrental_list_invoices, pointofrental_get_invoice, pointofrental_list_work_orders, pointofrental_get_work_order, pointofrental_list_line_items, pointofrental_list_locations, pointofrental_list_depots, pointofrental_list_categories, pointofrental_create_contact, pointofrental_update_contact, pointofrental_create_customer, pointofrental_update_customer · Public sink: pointofrental_list_contacts, pointofrental_create_contact, pointofrental_create_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
